statement: A session record (a token family) carries its format and is read by the reader's rule: a member a later version adds is ignored unless the record's crit names it (SNP-27), a record written before formats is format 1, and a later format, or a member crit names that this version does not know, is refused: the refresh, logout or switch that read it is answered 503, the session is kept and never rewritten, and an instance of the later version reads it; a refused record never reads as another one.
guards: cocache:TokenFamilyFormatTest#a session is written with its format
cocache:TokenFamilyFormatTest#a session written before formats is format 1
cocache:TokenFamilyFormatTest#a member a later version adds is ignored, and a missing rotation is the first generation
cocache:TokenFamilyFormatTest#a later format, or a session that lacks what it needs, is refused as a format error
login:LaterSessionRecordTest#a refresh of a session a later version wrote is an outage, and the record is never rewritten
